adopted_replan.reason: C8 legacy request turns the adopted re-plan into a committed repair record and `repair requested` row before selection; C6 planning then targets that repair row.

mixed_none_blocked.reason: Superagent WAITING FOR RUN gives a BLOCKED report and unresolved code PR precedence over `none`; C9 also classifies an open-PR closeout as BLOCKED.

closeout_repair.reason: C4 applies the valid C8 repair override despite predecessor Plan, Closeout, and banner; C6 targets it in planning mode and skips it in execution mode.

merged.reason: C9 accepts a completed active leaf only with verified PR MERGED state, merge commit on main, and tracked closeout, all of which are present.

declined.reason: C9 accepts a recorded authorized declined disposition with its reason and PR disposition, alongside the separately verified merged leaf.

fresh_tick.reason: C8 replay requires an adopted legacy decision lacking a record to create the same durable request before dispatch; C6 then selects `repair requested` for planning.

successor.reason: After C8 publication, the successor is the ordinary active leaf; C6 execution selects its ready, unclosed plan, while predecessor links are history.

stale_ancestor.reason: C9 must recurse through active links even when an ancestor is closed; the hidden `executed — PR open` leaf is BLOCKED and invokes the decision ladder.

missing_evidence.reason: C9 requires verifiable PR merge and main-history integration; unknown evidence is BLOCKED, never optimistic completion.

late_closeout.reason: C7 says a predecessor closeout must not advance a row whose active Plan points to a successor; it is recorded only as historical evidence.

replay.reason: C8 replay says that when the record names a successor and the active link agrees, continue from that successor without resetting the row or creating another successor.

hidden_ready.reason: C9 classifies ordinary ready/unplanned work hidden by a closed ancestor as BLOCKED until authorized reconciliation restores reachability.

second_repair.reason: C8 treats the verified P0 → P1 → P2 chain as earlier historical repair plus the latest unresolved request; it selects active P2 and does not duplicate a successor.

declined_repair.reason: C8 makes an authorized declined repair with matching evidence settled even if its successor was pending, so replay must not reopen it; C9 accepts the recorded disposition.

direct_merge.reason: C9 accepts direct/no-PR work when its recorded integration commit is verified on local main where no remote exists and the closeout is tracked.

closed_pr.reason: C9 treats a closed-but-unmerged PR with no authorized disposition or successor as BLOCKED, despite a closeout link.
